dialogue.origin: 相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 中学3年生の娘を持つ親です。娘がコロナ休暇明けに3日ほど、学校に行ってから、不登校になり悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm the parent of a third-year middle school student. I'm worried because my daughter stopped going to school after attending for only about three days after the COVID break.

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんが心配ですね。。
dialogue.content: You must be worried about your daughter.

dialogue.origin: はい…中3で大事な時期なので心配です
dialogue.content: Yes... It's a crucial time for her since she's in her third year of middle school, so I'm worried.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。進路のこともありますもんね。。
dialogue.content: I understand. There's also her future path to consider, isn't there?

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんはこの件についてどのようにおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: What has your daughter said about this?

dialogue.origin: 学校に行きたくないと、言って、部屋に閉じこもるようになりました。
dialogue.content: She says she doesn't want to go to school and has started shutting herself in her room.

dialogue.origin: どうしたら良いか…
dialogue.content: I don't know what to do...

dialogue.origin: 困惑しますよね。。
dialogue.content: That must be very confusing for you.

dialogue.origin: ご自宅ではどのようなご様子ですか？
dialogue.content: How has she been at home?

dialogue.origin: あまり、食欲がないらしく、毎食ごはんを作って部屋に持っていっているのですが、少し残しています。
dialogue.content: It seems she doesn't have much of an appetite. I make her meals and bring them to her room, but she leaves some of it uneaten.

dialogue.origin: 学校のことも、詳しく教えてくれません…
dialogue.content: She won't tell me much about what's going on at school either...

dialogue.origin: 食欲がいつもよりないのは余計に不安ですね。。
dialogue.content: It must be extra worrying that her appetite isn't what it usually is.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 担任の先生や学校のお友達から状況をお聞きになっているかと思いますが、どんな感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I imagine you've heard something from her homeroom teacher or friends at school about the situation—what have they said?

dialogue.origin: 実は、最初から、あまり友達が多いほうではなく、大人しい子なんです。先生からは、保健室登校は、どうですか？とか、スクールカウンセラーに話をしてみたら？と言われています
dialogue.content: Actually, she's a quiet girl and has never had a lot of friends. Her teacher suggested that she could try attending school in the nurse's office, or that we could talk to the school counselor.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: とは言え娘さんからあまり話してくれないから心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: Even so, it must be worrying that your daughter won't talk to you much about it.

dialogue.origin: 私の育て方が悪かったのかと落ち込みます
dialogue.content: I feel down, wondering if I did something wrong in raising her.

dialogue.origin: 悲しくなってしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: That must make you feel very sad.

dialogue.origin: えぇ…中学2年のときに、男の子に暗いとかブスと言われたことがあると言っていたことがあります。そういえば！
dialogue.content: Yes... Come to think of it, she once told me that in her second year of middle school, a boy called her 'gloomy' and 'ugly'!

dialogue.origin: そういうことがあったのですね。。
dialogue.content: So, something like that happened.

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんはそのときどのような様子でしたか？
dialogue.content: How did your daughter seem at the time?

dialogue.origin: やはり悲しそうでした。それを聞いて、私まで悲しくなったし、少し怒りも覚えました！
dialogue.content: She seemed very sad, of course. Hearing that made me sad too, and I also felt a little angry!

dialogue.origin: 大事な娘さんが悲しんでいるのを見るのは苦しいですよね。。
dialogue.content: It must be painful to see your precious daughter so sad.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんは悲しい気持ちを頑張ってあなたに伝えられたのかも知れませんね。
dialogue.content: Your daughter might have gathered all her courage to tell you how sad she was feeling.

dialogue.origin: えぇ…その時、担任の先生に相談したんです。
dialogue.content: Yes... I consulted with her homeroom teacher at the time.

dialogue.origin: でも…その時は、なんとかまだ学校に行っていたので、
dialogue.content: But... back then, she was still managing to go to school, so...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何もしてくれなかったというか
dialogue.content: It's like they didn't do anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私も、不登校になるなんて、思いもせず…
dialogue.content: I never imagined she would stop going to school...

dialogue.origin: 責任を感じてしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: You must feel a sense of responsibility.

dialogue.origin: はい…でも、苦しいのは娘で、なんとかしようにも、とにかく元気がなく…
dialogue.content: Yes... But it's my daughter who's suffering, and even though I want to do something, she's just so listless...

dialogue.origin: もどかしいですよね。。
dialogue.content: That must be frustrating.

dialogue.origin: お嬢さんは趣味や、何か好きで取り組まれているものはありますか？
dialogue.content: Does your daughter have any hobbies or things she enjoys doing?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…小説や漫画を読んだり、ゲームしたりですかね
dialogue.content: Let's see... I guess she reads novels and manga, and plays video games.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。お部屋にいる時間が多いようなので、本やゲームに触れられているなら少しは安心ですね。
dialogue.content: I see. Since she spends a lot of time in her room, it's a bit reassuring that she's still engaging with books and games.

dialogue.origin: えぇ…ただ、受験生でもあるので、勉強の遅れが気になります。でも、不登校になっている以上、今現在の問題が気がかりですよね。夫は、行きたくないなら、無理することないじゃないかとだけ言っています
dialogue.content: Yes... But she's also preparing for high school entrance exams, so I'm concerned about her falling behind in her studies. But with her not going to school, the current problem is my main concern. My husband just says, 'If she doesn't want to go, there's no need to force her.'

dialogue.origin: じゃあどうすればいいのよ！とわたし1人でモヤモヤしています。
dialogue.content: So then what am I supposed to do?! I'm the only one feeling so frustrated and uncertain.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。娘さんの将来のことを考えるからこそモヤモヤしてしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: I understand. It's precisely because you're thinking about your daughter's future that you feel so unsettled.

dialogue.origin: 不登校になってからどれくらいの月日が経っていますか？
dialogue.content: How long has it been since she stopped going to school?

dialogue.origin: 6月のはじめから行っていないので、もう1ヶ月半弱ですね…
dialogue.content: She hasn't gone since the beginning of June, so it's been just under a month and a half...

dialogue.origin: 教材を買って与えたのですが、あまりやっている気配はありません
dialogue.content: I bought her study materials, but there's no sign she's using them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。確かに学業の面が心配になりますね。。
dialogue.content: I see. The academic side is certainly a concern.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんは進路について何かおっしゃっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Has your daughter said anything about her future path?

dialogue.origin: えぇ。高校には行きたいと。でも、学校に行くのは嫌だと！それは頑固に言い続けています
dialogue.content: Yes. She says she wants to go to high school. But she doesn't want to go to her current school! She's very stubborn about that.

dialogue.origin: その意志ははっきりと示されているんですね。
dialogue.content: So she's made that intention clear.

dialogue.origin: えぇ。やはり、中学のクラスの友達が嫌なのかなと
dialogue.content: Yes. I suspect she just doesn't like her junior high classmates.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるんですね。
dialogue.content: You feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 高校は具体的にどこの高校が良いとか、そのようなことはおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: Has she said anything specific, like which high school she'd like to go to?

dialogue.origin: えぇ…友達が嫌としても、勉強はしてほしいんですけど
dialogue.content: Yes... even if she dislikes her friends, I still want her to study.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 高校は、確かに今住んでいるところから、遠い高校なので、
dialogue.content: The high school she wants to go to is indeed far from where we live, so,

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: その友達たちとは離れられるかもしれませんが、
dialogue.content: she might be able to get away from those friends, but,

dialogue.origin: そうですね、
dialogue.content: That's true,

dialogue.origin: また、高校で何かあったら、どうするのかと先に先に、親が不安になっています
dialogue.content: as a parent, I'm already worrying ahead, thinking about what we'll do if something happens again in high school.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じになるのですね。。
dialogue.content: I can see why you would feel that way.

dialogue.origin: えぇ…グルグル考えてしまいます
dialogue.content: Yes... My thoughts just keep going around in circles.

dialogue.origin: 心配が募りますね。。
dialogue.content: Your worries must be piling up.

dialogue.origin: 母親失格だわとか
dialogue.content: Like I'm a failure as a mother.

dialogue.origin: 心苦しく思ってしまいますよね。。
dialogue.content: That must be heartbreaking to think about.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話をお聞きして感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: May I share with you what I've felt listening to your story so far?

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 娘さんが苦しんでる様子を見て一緒に苦しんで、進路のことを考えて教材を買ってあげたり、お母さまとして本当に娘さんのことを大切に思って行動していらっしゃることがとても伝わってきました。
dialogue.content: Seeing your daughter suffer and suffering along with her, thinking about her future and buying her study materials... it's very clear to me that as a mother, you truly care for your daughter and are acting out of that love.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: だからこそ娘さんはあなたを信頼して、つらかったことを素直に打ち明け、中学校に行きたくないということや高校には行きたいということをちゃんと伝えられています。
dialogue.content: That's why your daughter trusts you enough to honestly confide in you about her painful experiences, and to clearly tell you that she doesn't want to go to middle school but does want to go to high school.

dialogue.origin: とは言え、高校に行くにも勉強をしていない現状は心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: That being said, the current situation where she isn't studying, even though she wants to go to high school, is understandably a cause for concern.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。苦しい胸の内は、娘にしかわかりませんが、現状はやはり心配です。
dialogue.content: That's right. Only my daughter knows the pain she's feeling inside, but the current situation is still very worrying.

dialogue.origin: せっかく具体的に行きたい高校があるので、その高校に行くためにはどうしたらよいか、ということを担任の先生と相談してみるのはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: Since she has a specific high school she wants to attend, how about discussing with her homeroom teacher what steps need to be taken to get there?

dialogue.origin: 学校に行ったとしても勉強していなければ希望の高校に行くことは困難でしょうし、逆に自宅学習でも勉強ができれば娘さんにとっては良いことかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Even if she went to school, it would be difficult to get into her desired high school without studying. Conversely, if she can study at home, that might be a good thing for her.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。先生も、心配してくれていますし、このままでは娘にとってもあまりよくないと思うので、しっかり娘の思いも聴きながら、進んでいきたいと思います！
dialogue.content: You're right. Her teacher is also concerned, and I don't think this situation is good for my daughter. I want to move forward while carefully listening to her feelings.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんと希望の高校に行くために一緒に作戦を考えよう！という風にできればよいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: It might be a good idea to approach it as, 'Let's come up with a plan together to get you into the high school you want!'

dialogue.origin: はい。高校に行きたいという思いはあるみたいなので、いろんな方の力を借りながら、娘と一緒に一歩ずつ歩いて行きたいと思います！
dialogue.content: Yes. It seems she does have the desire to go to high school, so I want to take it one step at a time with her, with the help of various people!

dialogue.origin: そうですね！いつもお嬢さんのことを考えてこられた素敵なあなたですから、お嬢さんもその思いに気付いてくれると信じています。
dialogue.content: That's right! You are a wonderful mother who has always thought about your daughter, and I believe your daughter will recognize that love.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談にこられていかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after coming in for a consultation today?

dialogue.origin: はい！モヤモヤしていたことが、聞いていただけで、少し和らぎました！ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes! Just having you listen has eased some of my muddled feelings. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: きいていただけて、ありがとうございました↑
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.origin: あなたと娘さんを心より応援しております。本日はご相談にきてくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm sincerely rooting for you and your daughter. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: はい！ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes! Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日のロールプレイを終了致します。
dialogue.content: That concludes today's role-play session.

topic.sub: 不登校の中学生の進路についての悩み
